observations.content: Completed audit of 14 workspace components for out-of-scope ports; found 3 new cases beyond known subagent-types: visual-tools stale host, duplicate researcher/learn-researcher roles, web-fetch name collision.

Audit finding: visual-tools targets globalThis.__pi_interactive_subagents registerToolExtension API, but interactive-subagents is not loaded in workspace (zero grep hits elsewhere); bridge silently no-ops via if (!api?.registerToolExtension) return guard on line 53, while tools work via direct pi extension loading through subagent-types' CUSTOM_TOOL_EXTENSIONS.

Audit finding: researcher and learn-researcher are duplicate roles with identical name/description 'Web researcher — searches the web and synthesizes findings', same model glm-5.3-flash, thinking high; learn-researcher adds safe_bash, system-prompt append, and auto-exit.

Audit finding: web-fetch extension registers a tool literally named web_fetch whose description matches assistant's live web_fetch tool verbatim, shadowing any built-in; also overlaps functionally with harness built-in fetch_content (URL to markdown, plus raw/answer modes).

Audit finding: safe_bash provenance unresolved via grep (only subagent-types/safe-bash.ts found, but 'safe_bash' registration grep returned empty), open low-priority question requiring runtime check via 'pi --mode rpc list tools'.

Audit verdict table listed clean components: ask-user-question (fork with deliberate differences), quiz, snip (port of prompt-snippets), observational-memory (near-verbatim port), pdf-reader, youtube-transcript, analyze-sessions (deliberately rebuilt for Paseo with old scripts parked in disabled-pi-scripts/), teach/visualize (custom by design), md-log (rewrite modeled on .md-link which no longer exists upstream).

Recommended actions: fix subagent-types 3-event channel (pending), clean visual-tools dead bridge and misleading header (10 min, no behavior change), merge researcher/learn-researcher or differentiate, decide web-fetch ownership and document which is live, add 'rewrite, no upstream' note to md-log header.
User instructed to merge the duplicate researcher/learn-researcher roles: 'bỏ cái thừa đi, để tên researcher và có safe_bash là xong' (drop the redundant one, keep name researcher with safe_bash).

User stated subagent-types was ported from the wrong source: 'mình port nhầm từ interactive-subagents rồi, bản mình muốn port phải là interactive-subagents' (the version they wanted to port should be interactive-subagents).

User asked whether, if using interactive-subagents, visual-tools would work just by fixing the name; user asked to evaluate the two duplicated web-fetch implementations comparing ease of use and consumption of limited resources; user suggested cloning the author's entire GitHub since the source code for oddball components must be there.
Verified tmux 3.5a is installed at /usr/bin/tmux, so interactive-subagents' tmux dependency is satisfiable.

GitHub API listed amosblomqvist's 6 repos: learn (My AI learning system), pi-config (My personal pi config), pi-dictate (Dictation extension for pi), pi-interactive-subagents (Interactive subagents running in tmux panes), pi-observational-memory (Memory system for pi), pi-subagents (Simple subagents for pi).
Grep of pi-coding-agent dist found no built-in web_fetch, suggesting assistant's web_fetch comes from the extension; cloned all 6 repos depth-1 into /tmp/ext-audit-2.

User reminded that the port is for use with Paseo, not to reproduce the extension's original design faithfully, citing the 2 build sessions discussed and files on disk, and asks assistant to proactively consult the logs.

Read pi-interactive-subagents README: sub-agents run async in tmux panes (tmux-only fork of upstream supporting cmux/zellij/WezTerm), subagent() returns immediately, results steered back as notification triggering new turn; tools subagent, subagent_message (address by name, typed into live pane picked up at next turn boundary, resumes session if finished), subagents_list, ask_question (sub-agent sessions only, parks as waiting, parent replies via subagent_message, reply absorbed into current turn if mid-turn); every spawn records name to artifact subagent-registry.json persisting across restarts; resume replays sandbox from <session>.loadout.json snapshot.

pi-interactive-subagents bundled agents include scout (openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3, tools read/grep/find/ls) and researcher (openrouter/z-ai/glm-5.3, tools web_search/web_fetch/safe_bash), matching the learn-researcher origin.

Grep of test-log.md for interactive/tmux/2-way-chiều/message_main/steer returned empty, indicating the build design discussions live in the build session transcripts (~/.pi/agent/sessions/), not test-log.md.

Noted convergence: interactive-subagents main-to-child is picked up at next turn boundary (not interrupt-and-replace), matching the assistant's proposed 3-event design semantics, validating the fix direction toward interactive-subagents philosophy on Paseo infrastructure.

Glob for session file matching c627c4a agent id failed (file empty), then grep -l on all session files for interactive-subagents/fire-and-forget/steerActiveTurn matched multiple files including 2026-08-30T00-06-06-262Z_01a04ffc-dab6-72fc-8dfa-2f0574c97f7e.jsonl.

Extracted design discussion from build session 2026-08-30T00-06-06: early system prompt told assistant it is a pure high-level orchestrator session that must outsource mechanical work to subagents and keep context lean, ask questions until 100% sure, do not act until user confirms shared understanding, and verify rather than guess; at 05:32 user asked to list tool names and confirm presence of bash, write, quiz, spawn_subagent, safe_bash; at 05:36 user asked to call subagent glm 5.3 flash to test since the model has vision.
